sections.heading: Storefront Glass Options for Commercial Properties
sections.body: Not all storefronts are built the same, and the right glass selection depends on your building's design requirements, traffic levels, and performance goals. For commercial properties in Tysons — from standalone retail pads near International Drive to multi-tenant office buildings along Leesburg Pike — we work with a range of glazing options including tempered safety glass, insulated glass units, laminated glass, and low-emissivity glass. Tempered glass offers added strength and a safer break pattern compared to standard annealed glass, making it a common choice for high-traffic storefronts. Insulated glass units can help improve thermal comfort for interior spaces. Laminated glass provides an added layer of security by holding together when broken. We discuss these options clearly with clients, helping you select a solution that fits your building's framing system, aesthetic requirements, and practical needs.
